properties.statement:
MEASURED ON THIS DESIGN 2026-08-10 (docs/design/reflow2.json at 5180a41, 183 Decisions excluding decision:ack: review records): the orphan_node rule for Decisions fires on 2, and 32 MORE sit in the state the rule's own comment describes as the harm, silenced by an edge that does not relieve it.

    degree-zero, detector fires                                     2
    edges ONLY of type AUTHORED_BY — silenced, still unreachable    32   (31 proposed, 1 accepted)

WHY THIS IS NOT THE NAIVE CLAIM. I first said AUTHORED_BY should not count toward the degree, and READING heal.rs:823-885 refuted that before it was written down. The degree-zero rule is deliberate and was settled by measurement, not taste: the narrow form (an accepted Decision with no incoming GOVERNED_BY) fires on SIX of reflow2's own, five of which have degree 1-3, and the comment names that as BL-42's shape exactly — the detector that became 20 of 31 defects and had to be cut back to one rule. The stated virtue is that ANY edge silences it, 'so it cannot grow into a per-convention nag'. That reasoning is sound and should not be undone.

THE NARROW THING THAT IS STILL TRUE. The rule's SILENCING CONDITION (any edge) is broader than the HARM IT NAMES. Its own words: a Decision with no edges 'cannot be reached by propagation, so it never enters an impact analysis; and for a disposition specifically it can never EXPIRE, because expiry is computed from the affected set'. AUTHORED_BY does not relieve either. The tool's own description says it is 'deliberately not a traceability edge, so it never enlarges a blast radius' — so a Decision whose only edge is AUTHORED_BY is exactly as propagation-unreachable as one with no edges, and exactly as unable to expire, while reporting clean. The population carrying that state is 16x the population reported.

THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST IS THE ACCEPTED ONE. dec:commitment-edges-survive-snapshots is accepted with a single AUTHORED_BY edge. The rule grades accepted orphans at WARNING with the message 'is accepted but governs nothing — nothing links to it, so it shapes no part of the design, cannot appear in any impact analysis'. That sentence is true of this node and the detector does not say it.

THE SKILL AND THE DETECTOR INTERACT TO PRODUCE THIS. The brainstorm skill instructs authored_by on every brainstormed Decision (step 3.5, 'whoever's idea it was'). Following it correctly moves a parked decision from degree-0 to degree-1 and out of the report. 31 of the 32 are proposed and most are dec:idea-* — this is the brainstorm population, made structurally invisible by doing the right thing. Reproduced live: dec:idea-does-a-session-open-by-comparing-the-record was created and authored the same day and did not appear in detect_defects.

WHAT WOULD BE THE WRONG FIX, recorded so nobody reaches for it: excluding AUTHORED_BY from the degree count would fire on 32 nodes at once, which is precisely the BL-42 explosion the degree-zero rule exists to prevent. If anything is done here it is probably narrower — the accepted-only case is ONE node today — or a distinct lower-severity reading rather than more orphan_node findings. Recorded as an observation with its own counter-argument, not as a repair proposal.

CONFIDENCE 0.9 rather than 1: the 32 is computed from the committed export at 5180a41, which trails the live graph by the two nodes this session added, and 'propagating edge' is taken from AUTHORED_BY's own documented non-traceability rather than from reading propagate.rs's edge set directly.
